summary: Facts below are the ones several September 2026 guides agreed on, or that the Roblox listing states. They are not an official balance patch.

facts.statement: Live Roblox title is Slayers 2 by Ouw Productions, place 16205713724.
The dungeon players mean is Ouwigahara.
facts.support: Multiple guides 2026-09-19 to 2026-09-24, not an official post

facts.statement: Ouwigahara unlock is level 65 via Blacksmith Togane in Hidden Mist Village and his other-forge quest.
facts.support: Same guide cluster. Exact button text differs, so the site tells players to use the on-screen forge line.

facts.statement: A purple portal is registered once, then Ouwigahara Normal is queued from the hub.
facts.support: AllThings.How and slayers2-game.wiki. The walk to the first portal differs between those guides, so the site says follow the quest marker.

facts.statement: About 90000 points in one run is the V2 score those guides use. The forge screen is the price.
facts.support: Multiple dungeon guides. Material counts and a 5-player cap were single-source and were not published.

facts.statement: ANIM4L (50 Spins and 5 Ores), BREATHRESET, ARTRESET, SPINS50, and SkillTreeReset were still listed active on 2026-09-26.
facts.support: Destructoid, Pocket Tactics, and other same-day lists

facts.statement: Release26 (30 Spins, 100 Wen, 1 Refinement Ore) was still listed by some 2026-09-26 pages and marked expired by GameRant on 2026-09-25.
facts.support: Conflict. Site status is disputed, not active.

facts.statement: Final Selection remains the separate level 45 exam.
facts.support: Existing cross-checked exam guides. It is not the dungeon.

unknowns: One GPS path to the first portal
Exact card values, floor counts, and V2 material counts
